releases.title: Richer terrain map and community configs
highlights: 3D minimap with player models, sky, atmosphere and shadows.
Browse, share, install and rate community configs.
New AutoEat module with hotbar refill and health-aware eating.
Combat, movement and Backtrack handoff fixes.

entries.text: Terrain Map and minimap now render loaded players with skins and model poses, plus sky, daylight, atmospheric distance and terrain/player shadows.
Corrected ground shadow filtering to prevent dark self-shadow stripes while preserving cast shadows.
The Config Manager has a Community tab for searching, sorting, previewing, installing, sharing, voting on and reporting configs without an account.
Community sharing strips keybinds before upload; installing a shared config preserves personal keybinds.
AutoEat chooses food by saturation, can eat to support health regeneration and refills the hotbar through normal inventory interactions.
KillAura, Scaffold and other automations no longer clear another module's movement or camera control during handoffs.
Combat automation yields while AutoEat uses food, and Backtrack handles target movement and presentation packets more precisely.
Public access no longer requires a beta key; sample community configs were removed from the online list.
Experimental FlowPath and Cinematic Replay modules are not available in this release.

releases.title: New modules and smoother combat controls
highlights: Seven new movement, player and visual modules.
Fixed KillAura turning and rotation release.
Improved target checks and combat timing.

entries.text: AutoWalk automatically walks forward and pauses while holding back or sneak.
AutoJump jumps while moving on the ground; automatic input is shared with KillAura movement prediction.
AutoRespawn adds a configurable death-screen delay and skips Hardcore worlds.
NoJumpDelay removes the local cooldown between held jumps.
NoHurtCam disables damage camera tilt.
TimeChanger adds Day, Sunset, Night, Midnight and Custom time presets while retaining server time updates.
WeatherChanger adds Clear, Rain and Thunder with adjustable strength. Disabling restores the current world weather.
Velocity adds Cancel, Percentage, Reverse, Push and Jump modes, independent horizontal/vertical scaling, explosion control, chance and ground filters, collision settings and jump delay.
Updated the Velocity packet hook signatures for the 1.21.10 and 1.21.11 adapters.
KillAura stops tracking without a target and smoothly releases its rotation after disabling, including while the mouse is moving.
Fixed excessive sideways rotation, inherited turning momentum and tracking lag against fast or strafing targets.
KillAura compares local and received target boxes, aims within their safe overlap and validates attacks against both geometries.
KillAura and AutoRod hand off the last sent rotation; TickBase pauses during their combat automation.
Combat click scheduling preserves timing across target changes and lag while respecting changing weapon cooldowns.
Optional combat tracing records rotation owners, packet timing and local/network target geometry for diagnosis.
Fixed cookie account login.
Reorganized the client around the standalone ellie engine and tightened the OpenGL rendering boundary in preparation for additional rendering backends.

releases.title: Gameplay, map, notification and nametag fixes
highlights: Updated toast notifications to the Material layout.
Fixed white nametags in light themes.
Fixed old death markers carrying over between SkyWars maps.

entries.text: Fixed scrollbar dragging in offset and scaled menus. The thumb now follows the pointer directly without jumping when grabbed.
Fixed ChestStealer not taking any items in some moments
Fixed BowAimbot flagging simulation & BadPackets
Fixed SilentSneak hiding automatic crouching visuals without changing sneak movement.
KillAura can select and attack invisible players.
Updated toast notifications to use Material cards, status icons and wrapped text.
Fixed white Minecraft-formatted nametags in light themes.
Improved player health bars and absorption colors.
Fixed TerrainMap keeping death markers from the previous SkyWars map.
Fixed a startup crash when restoring saved Terrain Map settings.
Disconnecting from a server now returns to the ellice Servers menu.
Added local .bind and .toggle chat commands with Tab completion for modules and keys, saved bindings and NONE to unbind.
Added cookie login to the AccountManager.
Command suggestions follow the active theme with keyboard, toggle and module icons, selection highlights and module status. Command results appear as Material notifications.
